security_auditor.name: Security Auditor
security_auditor.prompt: Security audit of this code. Check for: XSS, SQL injection, hardcoded secrets (AWS keys, tokens, API keys), env leaks, unsafe crypto/parsing patterns. Be strict. Only flag issues, don't praise.

code_reviewer.name: Code Reviewer
code_reviewer.prompt: Quick code review. Check: (1) Commit message clear & follows conventions? (2) Changes align with message? (3) Any obvious bugs or logic errors? (4) Dead code or unused imports? Flag only blockers.
code_reviewer.format:
✅ Safe to commit
OR
🔴 BLOCKER: [Issue]
Fix: [Action]

pre_push_validator.name: Pre-Push Validator
pre_push_validator.prompt: Pre-push validation. Check: (1) Correct branch? (2) Any secrets in commits? (3) Follows conventions? (4) Ready for production? Flag only blockers.
pre_push_validator.format:
✅ Safe to push
OR
🛑 BLOCKER: [Issue]
Fix: [Action]

dependency_auditor.name: Dependency Auditor
dependency_auditor.prompt: Audit new dependencies. Check: (1) Known vulnerabilities (CVE)? (2) Outdated security patches? (3) Conflicting versions? (4) Unnecessary bloat? Suggest better alternatives if found.
dependency_auditor.format:
✅ Dependencies look good
OR
🔴 SECURITY: [Issue]
Risk: [CVE/Severity]
Fix: [Update or alternative]

batch_summarizer.name: Batch Summarizer
batch_summarizer.prompt: Summarize what just ran in 1 sentence. Flag any errors. Suggest next logical step. Is there a blocker?

commit_message_validator.name: Commit Message Validator
commit_message_validator.prompt: Validate commit message follows conventional commits (fix:, feat:, docs:, test:, refactor:, chore:). Message should be clear, <50 chars. Does it follow format?
commit_message_validator.format:
✅ Message valid
OR
🔴 Fix: [What's wrong]
Suggested: [Better message]

test_runner.name: Test Runner
test_runner.prompt: Run test suite and report: Did tests pass? Any failures? Coverage impact?
test_runner.format:
✅ All tests pass
OR
❌ Tests failed: [Failed tests]
Fix: [Suggestion]

coverage_auditor.name: Coverage Auditor
coverage_auditor.prompt: Check test coverage for this change. Are new lines tested? Is coverage dropping? Suggest missing tests.
coverage_auditor.format:
Coverage: [%]
Missing: [What needs tests]
Suggestion: [Test to write]

performance_detector.name: Performance Regression Detector
performance_detector.prompt: Check for performance regressions. Are new loops, nested calls, or expensive operations added? Could it be slower than before?
performance_detector.format:
✅ Performance OK
OR
⚠️ PERF: [Issue]
Risk: [Estimated impact]
Fix: [Optimization]

dead_code_detector.name: Dead Code Detector
dead_code_detector.prompt: Find unused code: unused variables, dead imports, unreachable branches, unused functions. Flag all.
dead_code_detector.format:
Unused: [List]
Lines: [Line numbers]
Action: [Delete or keep?]

lazy_flow.name: Lazy Flow (Lint → Test → Commit → Push → PR)

release_flow.name: Release Flow (Version → Changelog → Tests → Tag → Publish)

github.description: Auto-create PRs and post reviews on push
